what: The injection set of every part of stage E1, fixed and hashed before any run: comparison rule 1 of the design D0, section 8.
how_worked: By a script that imports hashlib and struct and nothing of this project, run on 2026-11-23 at 14:08:39 by the clock, before learn/ or E1's script existed; the seven digests were appended to the round's ledger at that time. The same arithmetic is written again in tests/test_lrn_a_e1.py (independent_digest), which the gate runs against this file and against model.records.digest.
a_set: Its truth records in order. The training trials first, record i at index 64 + 128 * i for i below N. Then the test trials, record i at index B + 64 + 128 * i, with B = 128 * N + 64 * calibration_scores. Every record: pulse_id 0, amplitude 1/1.
a_record: 18 bytes, little-endian: index as 8 unsigned, pulse_id as 2 unsigned, amplitude_num as 4 signed, amplitude_den as 4 unsigned.
a_digest: SHA-256 over the ASCII bytes of 'undertone-records', one zero byte, the ASCII bytes of 'truth', one zero byte, then every record's 18 bytes.
first_record_by_hand: Index 64 is hex 40, so 40 00 00 00 00 00 00 00; pulse 0 is 00 00; numerator 1 is 01 00 00 00; denominator 1 is 01 00 00 00.
